analyst.summary: TMPV's India PV+EV business is compounding fast (Q1 FY27 volumes +46% YoY, EV dispatches +112% YoY, Curvv/Harrier/Sierra EV portfolio broadening) but is losing EV category share to Mahindra and JSW MG (Tata's EV share down from 53.4% in FY25 to ~38-39% now) and sits only #3 in overall domestic PV by volume. JLR -- the dominant earnings driver -- is mid-recovery from the Sep-2025 cyberattack (our internal PIT data confirms an actual quarterly net loss of Rs -3,483cr in the Dec-2025 quarter) but the recovery has not yet shown up in volumes: Q1 FY27 wholesales fell 9.2% YoY and China collapsed 26.2%, even as JLR's own FY27 guidance (4% EBIT margin) undershot Street expectations and triggered an 8.27% single-day stock drop in June 2026. Stripping the one-off demerger gain from FY26 PAT, we calculate a clean trailing P/E of ~19.3x against a market cap of Rs 1,23,587cr (price Rs 336, ~25% off the 52-week high) and P/B of 1.10x -- not table-pounding cheap, but not demanding a flawless recovery either. Call: Hold, with a genuine (flagged) Hold-vs-Sell tension given JLR's first post-guidance quarter already missing the recovery narrative.
